_about: Monsoon rush (docs/modes/monsoon-rush-design.md, deep dive D.1-D.5, sections 7-8). Levels are data (level 1 complete, later levels list only what changes, Cook's rule); calls are generated by js/monsoon/calls.js. Words: data/cook.json `words` plus the placeholders below (kutchi null: grey English until the family gives the word; never invent Kutchi). Spoken lines are cook.json `lines` keys (hey, and, then, no) plus grammar.number ('#number'). Timing per clip: data/monsoon-audio.json. Pot positions: data/scenes/kitchen-monsoon.json.
_menu_words: Food words an English speaker already knows from menus: never called as a target (they stay on the island as look-alikes). Zafar to tick the final list (design 6.6).

stageRule._about: D.7: in Busy a late answer never counts against a word; a wrong one counts half; a word moves at most one stage per storm. Drizzle misses count as Cook's do.

drizzle._about: Drizzle (Relaxed): the drop waits for the answer. After repeatAfter s Nani says the call again (free the first time); giveUpAfter is only a lab/test cap, so a bot that never answers still ends.

g1.name: The kitchen leak
g1.goal: Hear which pot the drip will hit, and lid it before it falls.

g2.name: Drip count
g2.goal: Let in as many drops as Nani says, then put the lid on.

g3.name: You call it
g3.goal: You're on the roof and can see the drip. Say the pot's name so Ali lids it.

g4.name: Nani's forecast
g4.goal: Nani can see the sky: tarp over for rain, back for sun, hold it in the wind, scoop Zazu at thunder.
g4._note: Phase 0 only: generated and graded headless; the courtyard station is phase 3. Every word is a placeholder: not yet a Kutchi test.

g6.name: Cats inside
g6.goal: Nani calls where a cat will pop out; open your arms there.
g6._note: Phase 0 only: generated and graded headless. The spots are placeholders (anchors) until the family gives them.

ear.name: Understood
ear.tip: Understood: you heard it before the drop fell

hand.name: Kept dry
hand.tip: Kept dry: most of the drops saved

relaxed.name: No help
relaxed.tip: No help: no replays, reveals or translations

busy.name: Quick ears
busy.tip: Quick ears: fast answers you'd heard

hints._about: Section 6.3: the first replay per storm is free; later replays, reveals and translations cost the No help star (Drizzle) or time (Busy).
